package teacherdialog

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain/repository"
)

// These tests exercise the dark S5 text path without a provider: the only
// semantic dependency is the typed AI Prompt port, and every persisted effect
// remains behind the local turn/store seams.
func TestOnboardingCoordinatorTextStagesOneSemanticTurnAndNextPrompt(t *testing.T) {
	fixture := newS5TextCoordinatorFixture(t)

	handled, err := fixture.coordinator.Process(context.Background(), fixture.job)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, handled)
	require.Equal(t, 1, fixture.semantic.interpretCalls)
	require.Zero(t, fixture.semantic.replayCalls)
	require.Equal(t, domain.DeterministicOnboardingUUID("semantic-ai", fixture.job.TeacherJobID), fixture.semantic.request.AIExecutionID)
	require.Equal(t, "Я знаю основы Go.", fixture.semantic.request.Variables.StudentTurn.Text)
	require.Equal(t, 1, fixture.studentTurns.applyCalls)
	require.Zero(t, fixture.studentTurns.getCalls)
	require.Len(t, fixture.jobs.responses, 1)
	require.Equal(t, string(domain.TeacherOnboardingCoordinatorText), fixture.jobs.responses[0].Mode)
	require.NotEmpty(t, fixture.jobs.responses[0].AssistantUI, "accepted text answer creates only the registry next prompt")
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnResponseStaged, fixture.turns.turn.Stage)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherOnboardingEffectAccepted, fixture.turns.turn.StudentEffectState)
	require.Contains(t, fixture.jobs.responses[0].Body, "Какой основной стек")
}

func TestOnboardingCoordinatorTextAcceptedResponseUsesDraftLocale(t *testing.T) {
	fixture := newS5TextCoordinatorFixture(t)
	language := "en"
	fixture.studentStates.state.Draft.PreferredLanguage = &language

	handled, err := fixture.coordinator.Process(context.Background(), fixture.job)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, handled)
	require.Len(t, fixture.jobs.responses, 1)
	require.Contains(t, fixture.jobs.responses[0].Body, "Which main stack")
}

func TestOnboardingCoordinatorTextHighImpactCandidateIsResponseOnly(t *testing.T) {
	fixture := newS5TextCoordinatorFixtureForStep(t, domain.OnboardingStepDirection)
	fixture.semantic.execution.Result.SlotCandidates[0].CodeValue = "data"

	handled, err := fixture.coordinator.Process(context.Background(), fixture.job)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, handled)
	require.Equal(t, 1, fixture.semantic.interpretCalls)
	require.Zero(t, fixture.studentTurns.applyCalls, "high-impact direction stays a deterministic confirmation path")
	require.Len(t, fixture.jobs.responses, 1)
	require.NotEmpty(t, fixture.jobs.responses[0].AssistantUI, "the server registry, not model JSON, creates a confirmation UI")
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecisionConfirmation, fixture.turns.turn.SemanticDecision.Kind)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherOnboardingEffectNotAttempted, fixture.turns.turn.StudentEffectState)
}

func TestOnboardingCoordinatorTextReplaysAIAndStudentAfterAmbiguousTransport(t *testing.T) {
	fixture := newS5TextCoordinatorFixture(t)
	fixture.semantic.interpretErr = errors.New("post acknowledgement lost")
	fixture.studentTurns.applyErr = context.DeadlineExceeded

	handled, err := fixture.coordinator.Process(context.Background(), fixture.job)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, handled)
	require.Equal(t, 1, fixture.semantic.interpretCalls)
	require.Equal(t, 1, fixture.semantic.replayCalls, "recovery must use the immutable causal AI key")
	require.Equal(t, 1, fixture.studentTurns.applyCalls)
	require.Equal(t, 1, fixture.studentTurns.getCalls, "Student timeout is recovered only by exact receipt read")
	require.Len(t, fixture.jobs.responses, 1)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnResponseStaged, fixture.turns.turn.Stage)
}

func TestOnboardingCoordinatorTextRecoversPersistedReplyWithoutAIReplay(t *testing.T) {
	fixture := newS5TextCoordinatorFixture(t)
	fixture.semantic.execution.Result.SlotCandidates = []domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticCandidate{}
	fixture.semantic.execution.Result.Questions = []domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticQuestion{}
	fixture.semantic.execution.Result.Uncertainties = []domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticUncertainty{}
	fixture.semantic.execution.Result.Response = "Сохранённый ответ на вопрос."
	decision, err := domain.NewTeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision(fixture.semantic.execution.Result, fixture.turns.interaction)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	fixture.turns.interaction.State = domain.TeacherOnboardingInteractionReserved
	fixture.turns.interaction.ReservedTeacherJobID = fixture.job.TeacherJobID
	fixture.turns.interaction.ReservationMode = domain.TeacherOnboardingCoordinatorText
	fixture.turns.turn = domain.TeacherOnboardingTurn{
		TeacherJobID: fixture.job.TeacherJobID, SourceEventID: fixture.job.Request.EventID, InteractionID: fixture.turns.interaction.ID,
		Mode: domain.TeacherOnboardingCoordinatorText, Stage: domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnAIStaged,
		CausalAIExecutionID: domain.DeterministicOnboardingUUID("semantic-ai", fixture.job.TeacherJobID),
		StudentCommandID:    domain.DeterministicOnboardingUUID("semantic-student", fixture.job.TeacherJobID), ResponseCommandID: domain.DeterministicOnboardingUUID("response", fixture.job.TeacherJobID),
		StudentEffectState: domain.TeacherOnboardingEffectNotAttempted, SemanticDecision: &decision,
		CreatedAt: fixture.turns.interaction.CreatedAt, UpdatedAt: fixture.turns.interaction.UpdatedAt,
	}
	fixture.turns.hasTurn = true
	fixture.turns.semanticResponse = fixture.semantic.execution.Result.Response

	handled, err := fixture.coordinator.Process(context.Background(), fixture.job)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, handled)
	require.Zero(t, fixture.semantic.interpretCalls)
	require.Zero(t, fixture.semantic.replayCalls)
	require.Zero(t, fixture.studentTurns.applyCalls)
	require.Len(t, fixture.jobs.responses, 1)
	require.Equal(t, fixture.semantic.execution.Result.Response, fixture.jobs.responses[0].Body)
}

func TestOnboardingCoordinatorTextReclaimsAIStagedDecisionAndAppliesStudentExactlyOnce(t *testing.T) {
	fixture := newS5TextCoordinatorFixture(t)
	decision, err := domain.NewTeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision(fixture.semantic.execution.Result, fixture.turns.interaction)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	fixture.turns.interaction.State = domain.TeacherOnboardingInteractionReserved
	fixture.turns.interaction.ReservedTeacherJobID = fixture.job.TeacherJobID
	fixture.turns.interaction.ReservationMode = domain.TeacherOnboardingCoordinatorText
	fixture.turns.turn = domain.TeacherOnboardingTurn{
		TeacherJobID: fixture.job.TeacherJobID, SourceEventID: fixture.job.Request.EventID, InteractionID: fixture.turns.interaction.ID,
		Mode: domain.TeacherOnboardingCoordinatorText, Stage: domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnAIStaged,
		CausalAIExecutionID: domain.DeterministicOnboardingUUID("semantic-ai", fixture.job.TeacherJobID),
		StudentCommandID:    domain.DeterministicOnboardingUUID("semantic-student", fixture.job.TeacherJobID), ResponseCommandID: domain.DeterministicOnboardingUUID("response", fixture.job.TeacherJobID),
		StudentEffectState: domain.TeacherOnboardingEffectNotAttempted, SemanticDecision: &decision,
		CreatedAt: fixture.turns.interaction.CreatedAt, UpdatedAt: fixture.turns.interaction.UpdatedAt,
	}
	fixture.turns.hasTurn = true
	fixture.turns.semanticResponse = fixture.semantic.execution.Result.Response

	handled, err := fixture.coordinator.Process(context.Background(), fixture.job)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, handled)
	require.Zero(t, fixture.semantic.interpretCalls)
	require.Zero(t, fixture.semantic.replayCalls)
	require.Equal(t, 1, fixture.studentTurns.applyCalls)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnResponseStaged, fixture.turns.turn.Stage)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherOnboardingEffectAccepted, fixture.turns.turn.StudentEffectState)
	require.Len(t, fixture.jobs.responses, 1)
	require.NotEmpty(t, fixture.jobs.responses[0].AssistantUI)
}

func TestOnboardingCoordinatorTextTangentPreservesCurrentInteractionWithoutStudentEffect(t *testing.T) {
	fixture := newS5TextCoordinatorFixture(t)
	fixture.semantic.execution.Result.SlotCandidates = []domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticCandidate{}
	fixture.semantic.execution.Result.Questions = []domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticQuestion{}
	fixture.semantic.execution.Result.Uncertainties = []domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticUncertainty{}
	fixture.semantic.execution.Result.Response = "Отвечу на вопрос и вернёмся к оценке опыта."

	handled, err := fixture.coordinator.Process(context.Background(), fixture.job)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, handled)
	require.Equal(t, 1, fixture.semantic.interpretCalls)
	require.Zero(t, fixture.studentTurns.applyCalls)
	require.Len(t, fixture.jobs.responses, 1)
	require.Empty(t, fixture.jobs.responses[0].AssistantUI, "a tangent may not manufacture UI from model output")
	require.Equal(t, "Отвечу на вопрос и вернёмся к оценке опыта.", fixture.jobs.responses[0].Body, "validated user-visible semantic reply is staged only on the job")
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherOnboardingEffectNotAttempted, fixture.turns.turn.StudentEffectState)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherOnboardingInteractionReserved, fixture.turns.interaction.State, "delivery atomically releases this reservation after Dialog accepts the response")
}

	fixture := newS5TextCoordinatorFixture(t)

	require.Equal(t, fixture.studentTurns.noEffectProofID, fixture.turns.turn.NoEffectProofID)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnResponseStaged, fixture.turns.turn.Stage)
}

	fixture.turns.interaction.State = domain.TeacherOnboardingInteractionCompleted
	fixture.turns.interaction.ReservedTeacherJobID = fixture.job.TeacherJobID

	require.Zero(t, fixture.studentTurns.applyCalls)

	require.Empty(t, fixture.jobs.responses[0].AssistantUI)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnResponseStaged, fixture.turns.turn.Stage)
	require.Empty(t, fixture.turns.turn.InteractionID)
}

}

func TestOnboardingCoordinatorCanonicalActionUsesReceiptAndZeroAI(t *testing.T) {
	fixture := newS5TextCoordinatorFixtureForStep(t, domain.OnboardingStepDirection)
	receiptID := "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa"
	fixture.job.Request.ActionReceiptID = receiptID
	fixture.job.Request.CorrelationID = receiptID
	receipt := domain.OnboardingActionReceipt{
		IdempotencyKey: receiptID, StudentID: fixture.job.Request.StudentID, PersonalTeacherID: fixture.job.Request.PersonalTeacherID,
		DialogID: fixture.job.Request.DialogID, SourceMessageID: fixture.job.Request.ReplyToMessageID, SourceMessageVersion: 1,
		BlockID: "onboarding.direction.d0.v1", ActionID: "direction.backend", Step: domain.OnboardingStepDirection, Status: domain.OnboardingReceiptMaterialized,
		ExecutionMode: domain.OnboardingActionExecutionCanonical, StudentCommandID: "bbbbbbbb-bbbb-4bbb-8bbb-bbbbbbbbbbbb",
		CanonicalStudentMessageID: fixture.job.Request.CanonicalStudentMessageID,
	}
	fixture.coordinator.Receipts = s5TextReceipts{receipt: receipt}

	handled, err := fixture.coordinator.Process(context.Background(), fixture.job)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, handled)
	require.Zero(t, fixture.semantic.interpretCalls, "canonical UI action is deterministic")
	require.Equal(t, 1, fixture.studentTurns.applyCalls)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherOnboardingSlotDirection, fixture.studentTurns.command.Slots[0].SlotCode)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherStudentTurnExplicitUI, fixture.studentTurns.command.Slots[0].Origin)
	require.Len(t, fixture.jobs.responses, 1)
	require.NotEmpty(t, fixture.jobs.responses[0].AssistantUI)
}

func TestProductAwareCoordinatorCallsPlannerAfterAcceptedEffectAndStagesFoundationTerminal(t *testing.T) {
	fixture := newProductAwareActionFixture(t)
	handled, err := fixture.coordinator.Process(context.Background(), fixture.job)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, handled)
	require.Zero(t, fixture.semantic.interpretCalls)
	require.Equal(t, 1, fixture.studentTurns.applyCalls)
	require.Equal(t, 1, fixture.readiness.calls)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef{Kind: domain.TeacherReadinessStateDraft, Version: 4}, fixture.readiness.refs[0])
	require.Len(t, fixture.productResponses.responses, 1)
	require.Contains(t, fixture.productResponses.responses[0].Body, domain.TeacherFoundationGoalDisplayName)
	require.Contains(t, fixture.productResponses.responses[0].Body, "ещё не созданы")
	require.Empty(t, fixture.productResponses.responses[0].AssistantUI)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnDeliveryPending, fixture.turns.turn.Stage)
}

func TestDurableHandoffCoordinatorTransfersReadyTurnWithoutStagingS7Response(t *testing.T) {
	fixture := newProductAwareActionFixture(t)
	fixture.turns.interaction.SessionSchemaVersion = 3
	handoffs := &s8CoordinatorHandoffs{}
	fixture.coordinator.Handoffs = handoffs
	fixture.coordinator.PlannerHandoffEnabled = false

	handled, err := fixture.coordinator.Process(context.Background(), fixture.job)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, handled)
	require.Equal(t, 1, fixture.studentTurns.applyCalls)
	require.Equal(t, 1, fixture.readiness.calls)
	require.Equal(t, 1, handoffs.calls)
	require.Equal(t, fixture.job.Request.EventID, handoffs.enqueue.EventID)
	require.Equal(t, fixture.job.ClaimToken, handoffs.enqueue.ClaimToken)
	require.Equal(t, fixture.job.TeacherJobID, handoffs.enqueue.Intent.SourceTeacherJobID)
	require.Equal(t, fixture.turns.interaction.ID, handoffs.enqueue.Intent.SourceInteractionID)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef{Kind: domain.TeacherReadinessStateDraft, Version: 4}, handoffs.enqueue.Intent.StateRef)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherFoundationGoalCode, handoffs.enqueue.Intent.Goal.Code)
	require.Empty(t, fixture.productResponses.responses, "S8 owns the READY notification after durable Planner acceptance")
	require.Empty(t, fixture.jobs.responses, "the source job is transferred, not staged for S7 delivery")
}

func TestPersistedV2TurnDoesNotUpgradeToHandoffFromCurrentFlag(t *testing.T) {
	fixture := newProductAwareActionFixture(t)
	handoffs := &s8CoordinatorHandoffs{}
	fixture.coordinator.Handoffs = handoffs
	fixture.coordinator.PlannerHandoffEnabled = true

	handled, err := fixture.coordinator.Process(context.Background(), fixture.job)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, handled)
	require.Zero(t, handoffs.calls)
	require.Len(t, fixture.productResponses.responses, 1)
}

func TestProductAwareTerminalDeliveryClosesPromptAcrossCrashRetry(t *testing.T) {
	fixture := newProductAwareActionFixture(t)
	handled, err := fixture.coordinator.Process(context.Background(), fixture.job)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, handled)
	require.Len(t, fixture.productResponses.responses, 1)

	response := fixture.productResponses.responses[0]
	fixture.job.CoordinatorMode = response.Mode
	fixture.job.ResponseBody = response.Body
	fixture.job.ResponseAssistantUI = response.AssistantUI
	appender := &s7DeliveryAppender{message: domain.DialogMessage{ID: "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999"}}
	deliveries := &s7DeliveryRecorder{failOnce: true}
	fixture.coordinator.Appender = appender
	fixture.coordinator.Deliveries = deliveries

	err = fixture.coordinator.Deliver(context.Background(), fixture.job)
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, context.DeadlineExceeded)
	err = fixture.coordinator.Deliver(context.Background(), fixture.job)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, 2, appender.calls)
	require.Equal(t, appender.keys[0], appender.keys[1], "retry reuses the exact durable response command")
	require.Equal(t, 2, deliveries.calls)
	require.False(t, deliveries.preserve)
	require.Nil(t, deliveries.next)
	require.Equal(t, 1, fixture.readiness.calls, "delivery recovery never calls Planner after response staging")
}

func TestProductAwareCoordinatorRetriesPlanner409OnlyAfterExactReceiptRecovery(t *testing.T) {
	fixture := newProductAwareActionFixture(t)
	fixture.readiness.errors = []error{domain.ErrTeacherLearningReadinessStale, nil}
	handled, err := fixture.coordinator.Process(context.Background(), fixture.job)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, handled)
	require.Equal(t, 2, fixture.readiness.calls)
	require.GreaterOrEqual(t, fixture.studentTurns.getCalls, 2)
	require.Len(t, fixture.productResponses.responses, 1)
}

func TestProductAwareCoordinatorPlannerFailureLeavesAcceptedTurnUnstagedAndRetryable(t *testing.T) {
	fixture := newProductAwareActionFixture(t)
	fixture.readiness.errors = []error{domain.ErrTeacherLearningReadinessUnavailable}
	handled, err := fixture.coordinator.Process(context.Background(), fixture.job)
	require.True(t, handled)
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrTeacherLearningReadinessUnavailable)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherOnboardingEffectAccepted, fixture.turns.turn.StudentEffectState)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnStudentStaged, fixture.turns.turn.Stage)
	require.Empty(t, fixture.productResponses.responses)
	require.Empty(t, fixture.jobs.responses)
}

	require.Len(t, fixture.jobs.responses, 1)
}

func TestProductAwareMultipleFactNoEffectPreservesPromptWithoutPlanner(t *testing.T) {
	fixture := newS5TextCoordinatorFixtureForStep(t, domain.OnboardingStepGoal)
	proofID := "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999"
	decision, err := domain.NormalizeTeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision(domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision{
		Kind: domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecisionMutation, PolicyVersion: domain.TeacherOnboardingPromptPolicyV2,
		Candidates: []domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticCandidate{
			{Slot: domain.TeacherOnboardingSlotGoalCode, CodeValue: "learn_programming", StringListValue: []string{}, ConfidenceBasisPoints: 9800},
			{Slot: domain.TeacherOnboardingSlotExperience, CodeValue: "beginner", StringListValue: []string{}, ConfidenceBasisPoints: 9700},
		},
	})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	turn := domain.TeacherOnboardingTurn{
		TeacherJobID: fixture.job.TeacherJobID, SourceEventID: fixture.job.Request.EventID, InteractionID: fixture.turns.interaction.ID,
		Mode: domain.TeacherOnboardingCoordinatorText, Stage: domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnStudentStaged,
		CausalAIExecutionID: "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa", StudentCommandID: "bbbbbbbb-bbbb-4bbb-8bbb-bbbbbbbbbbbb",
		ResponseCommandID: "cccccccc-cccc-4ccc-8ccc-cccccccccccc", StudentEffectState: domain.TeacherOnboardingEffectNoEffect,
		NoEffectProofID: proofID, SemanticDecision: &decision, CreatedAt: fixture.turns.interaction.CreatedAt, UpdatedAt: fixture.turns.interaction.CreatedAt,
	}
	turn, err = domain.NewTeacherOnboardingTurn(turn)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	fixture.turns.turn, fixture.turns.hasTurn = turn, true
	readiness := &s7Readiness{}
	fixture.coordinator.Readiness = readiness

	err = fixture.coordinator.stageTextResponse(context.Background(), fixture.job, turn, fixture.turns.interaction, decision, "ignored model wording", domain.TeacherOnboardingPromptPolicyV2)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Zero(t, readiness.calls)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnResponseStaged, fixture.turns.turn.Stage)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherOnboardingEffectNoEffect, fixture.turns.turn.StudentEffectState)
	require.Len(t, fixture.jobs.responses, 1)
	require.Empty(t, fixture.jobs.responses[0].AssistantUI)
}

func TestProductAwareCoordinatorAppliesMultipleLowRiskFactsInOneAtomicStudentPatch(t *testing.T) {
	fixture := newS5TextCoordinatorFixtureForStep(t, domain.OnboardingStepDirection)
	body, ui, err := domain.BuildProductAwareTeacherOnboardingPrompt(domain.OnboardingStepGoal, "ru", 0)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	now := fixture.turns.interaction.CreatedAt
	binding, err := domain.NewTeacherDialogBinding(domain.TeacherDialogBinding{ID: fixture.job.Request.DialogID, StudentID: fixture.job.Request.StudentID, PersonalTeacherID: fixture.job.Request.PersonalTeacherID, ContextType: domain.LearningContextGeneral})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	prompt := domain.DialogMessage{ID: fixture.job.Request.ReplyToMessageID, DialogID: fixture.job.Request.DialogID, AuthorType: domain.DialogMessageAuthorPersonalTeacher, Channel: domain.DialogMessageChannelWeb, PersonalTeacherID: fixture.job.Request.PersonalTeacherID, Body: body, AssistantUI: ui, Status: 1, Version: 1, MessageSequence: 1, LastEventSequence: 1, CreatedAt: now}
	interaction, err := domain.NewS5OnboardingInteraction(binding, prompt, domain.OnboardingStepGoal, 0, 0, 2, now)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	fixture.turns.interaction = interaction
	source := domain.DialogMessage{ID: fixture.job.Request.SourceMessageID, DialogID: fixture.job.Request.DialogID, AuthorType: domain.DialogMessageAuthorUser, Channel: domain.DialogMessageChannelWeb, SenderID: fixture.job.Request.StudentID, ReplyToMessageID: prompt.ID, Body: "Хочу научиться программировать, начинаю с нуля, материалы на русском.", Status: 1, Version: 1, MessageSequence: 2, LastEventSequence: 2, CreatedAt: now}
	fixture.coordinator.DialogReader = s5TextDialogContext{value: domain.DialogRequestContext{DialogID: fixture.job.Request.DialogID, StudentID: fixture.job.Request.StudentID, PersonalTeacherID: fixture.job.Request.PersonalTeacherID, ContextType: domain.LearningContextGeneral, SourceMessageID: source.ID, Messages: []domain.DialogMessage{prompt, source}}}
	fixture.semantic.execution.Result, err = domain.NormalizeTeacherOnboardingSemanticResult(domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticResult{Schema: domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticSchemaCode, Response: "Понял.", SlotCandidates: []domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticCandidate{
		{Slot: domain.TeacherOnboardingSlotGoalCode, CodeValue: "learn_programming", StringListValue: []string{}, ConfidenceBasisPoints: 9800},
		{Slot: domain.TeacherOnboardingSlotExperience, CodeValue: "beginner", StringListValue: []string{}, ConfidenceBasisPoints: 9700},
		{Slot: domain.TeacherOnboardingSlotLanguage, CodeValue: "ru", StringListValue: []string{}, ConfidenceBasisPoints: 9600},
	}, Questions: []domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticQuestion{}, Uncertainties: []domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticUncertainty{}})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	readiness := &s7Readiness{result: domain.TeacherLearningReadiness{Schema: domain.TeacherLearningReadinessSchema, Result: domain.TeacherLearningReadinessNeedsClarification,
		ReasonCodes: []string{domain.TeacherReadinessReasonProfileIncomplete}, ResolverVersion: domain.TeacherLearningReadinessResolver,
		StateRef: domain.TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef{Kind: domain.TeacherReadinessStateDraft, Version: 1}, ReadinessScope: domain.TeacherLearningReadinessScope, ContentStatus: domain.TeacherLearningContentNotCreated}}
	productResponses := &s7ProductResponses{turns: fixture.turns}
	fixture.coordinator.Readiness, fixture.coordinator.ProductResponses = readiness, productResponses
	handled, err := fixture.coordinator.Process(context.Background(), fixture.job)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, handled)
	require.Equal(t, 1, fixture.studentTurns.applyCalls)
	require.Len(t, fixture.studentTurns.command.Slots, 3)
	require.Equal(t, int64(1), fixture.studentStates.state.Draft.Version)
	require.Len(t, productResponses.responses, 1)
	require.Contains(t, productResponses.responses[0].Body, "направление")
	require.NotContains(t, productResponses.responses[0].Body, "цель")
}

func newProductAwareActionFixture(t *testing.T) s7ProductFixture {
	t.Helper()
	fixture := newS5TextCoordinatorFixtureForStep(t, domain.OnboardingStepDirection)
	goal, experience, language := "learn_programming", "beginner", "ru"
	fixture.studentStates.state.Draft.Version = 3
	fixture.studentStates.state.Draft.GoalCode = &goal
	fixture.studentStates.state.Draft.SelfAssessedExperience = &experience
	fixture.studentStates.state.Draft.PreferredLanguage = &language
	now := fixture.turns.interaction.CreatedAt
	fixture.studentStates.state.Draft.CreatedAt, fixture.studentStates.state.Draft.UpdatedAt = &now, &now
	body, ui, err := domain.BuildProductAwareTeacherOnboardingPrompt(domain.OnboardingStepDirection, "ru", 3)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	binding, err := domain.NewTeacherDialogBinding(domain.TeacherDialogBinding{ID: fixture.job.Request.DialogID, StudentID: fixture.job.Request.StudentID, PersonalTeacherID: fixture.job.Request.PersonalTeacherID, ContextType: domain.LearningContextGeneral})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	prompt := domain.DialogMessage{ID: fixture.job.Request.ReplyToMessageID, DialogID: fixture.job.Request.DialogID, AuthorType: domain.DialogMessageAuthorPersonalTeacher, Channel: domain.DialogMessageChannelWeb, PersonalTeacherID: fixture.job.Request.PersonalTeacherID, Body: body, AssistantUI: ui, Status: 1, Version: 1, MessageSequence: 1, LastEventSequence: 1, CreatedAt: now}
	interaction, err := domain.NewS5OnboardingInteraction(binding, prompt, domain.OnboardingStepDirection, 3, 0, 2, now)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	fixture.turns.interaction = interaction
	source := domain.DialogMessage{ID: fixture.job.Request.SourceMessageID, DialogID: fixture.job.Request.DialogID, AuthorType: domain.DialogMessageAuthorUser, Channel: domain.DialogMessageChannelWeb, SenderID: fixture.job.Request.StudentID, ReplyToMessageID: prompt.ID, Body: "Выбираю: Не знаю", Status: 1, Version: 1, MessageSequence: 2, LastEventSequence: 2, CreatedAt: now}
	fixture.coordinator.DialogReader = s5TextDialogContext{value: domain.DialogRequestContext{DialogID: fixture.job.Request.DialogID, StudentID: fixture.job.Request.StudentID, PersonalTeacherID: fixture.job.Request.PersonalTeacherID, ContextType: domain.LearningContextGeneral, SourceMessageID: source.ID, Messages: []domain.DialogMessage{prompt, source}}}
	receiptID := "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa"
	fixture.job.Request.ActionReceiptID, fixture.job.Request.CorrelationID = receiptID, receiptID
	receipt := domain.OnboardingActionReceipt{IdempotencyKey: receiptID, StudentID: fixture.job.Request.StudentID, PersonalTeacherID: fixture.job.Request.PersonalTeacherID, DialogID: fixture.job.Request.DialogID,
		SourceMessageID: prompt.ID, SourceMessageVersion: 1, BlockID: "onboarding.direction.d3.v2", ActionID: "direction.undecided", Step: domain.OnboardingStepDirection,
		Status: domain.OnboardingReceiptMaterialized, ExecutionMode: domain.OnboardingActionExecutionCanonical, StudentCommandID: "bbbbbbbb-bbbb-4bbb-8bbb-bbbbbbbbbbbb", CanonicalStudentMessageID: fixture.job.Request.CanonicalStudentMessageID}
	fixture.coordinator.Receipts = s5TextReceipts{receipt: receipt}
	readiness := &s7Readiness{result: domain.TeacherLearningReadiness{Schema: domain.TeacherLearningReadinessSchema, Result: domain.TeacherLearningReadinessReady,
		ReasonCodes: []string{domain.TeacherReadinessReasonFoundationGraphResolved}, ResolverVersion: domain.TeacherLearningReadinessResolver,
		StateRef: domain.TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef{Kind: domain.TeacherReadinessStateDraft, Version: 4}, ReadinessScope: domain.TeacherLearningReadinessScope,
		ContentStatus: domain.TeacherLearningContentNotCreated, Goal: &domain.TeacherLearningReadinessGoal{Code: domain.TeacherFoundationGoalCode, Version: domain.TeacherFoundationGoalVersion, GraphVersion: domain.TeacherFoundationGraphVersion}}}
	productResponses := &s7ProductResponses{turns: fixture.turns}
	fixture.coordinator.Readiness, fixture.coordinator.ProductResponses = readiness, productResponses
	return s7ProductFixture{s5TextCoordinatorFixture: fixture, readiness: readiness, productResponses: productResponses}
}

type s7Readiness struct {
	result domain.TeacherLearningReadiness
	errors []error
	refs   []domain.TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef
	calls  int
}

func (stub *s7Readiness) ResolveLearningReadiness(_ context.Context, _ string, ref domain.TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef) (domain.TeacherLearningReadiness, error) {
	stub.refs = append(stub.refs, ref)
	index := stub.calls
	stub.calls++
	if index < len(stub.errors) && stub.errors[index] != nil {
		return domain.TeacherLearningReadiness{}, stub.errors[index]
	}
	return stub.result, nil
}

type s7ProductResponses struct {
	turns     *s5TextTurns
	responses []domain.TeacherCoordinatedDialogResponse
}

type s7DeliveryAppender struct {
	message domain.DialogMessage
	keys    []string
	calls   int
}

func (appender *s7DeliveryAppender) AppendTeacherCoordinatedResponse(_ context.Context, _ domain.DialogTeacherRequest, key string, _ domain.TeacherCoordinatedDialogResponse) (domain.DialogMessage, error) {
	appender.calls++
	appender.keys = append(appender.keys, key)
	return appender.message, nil
}

type s7DeliveryRecorder struct {
	failOnce bool
	calls    int
	next     *domain.TeacherOnboardingInteraction
	preserve bool
}

func (store *s7DeliveryRecorder) CompleteOnboardingDelivery(_ context.Context, _, _, _ string, next *domain.TeacherOnboardingInteraction, preserve bool, _ time.Time) error {
	store.calls++
	store.next, store.preserve = next, preserve
	if store.failOnce {
		store.failOnce = false
		return context.DeadlineExceeded
	}
	return nil
}

func (store *s7ProductResponses) StageProductAwareOnboardingResponse(_ context.Context, _, _ string, response domain.TeacherCoordinatedDialogResponse, now time.Time) error {
	store.responses = append(store.responses, response)
	store.turns.turn.Stage = domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnDeliveryPending
	store.turns.turn.UpdatedAt = now
	return nil
}

	semantic      *s5TextSemantic

func newS5TextCoordinatorFixture(t *testing.T) s5TextCoordinatorFixture {
	return newS5TextCoordinatorFixtureForStep(t, domain.OnboardingStepExperience)
}

func newS5TextCoordinatorFixtureForStep(t *testing.T, step domain.TeacherOnboardingStep) s5TextCoordinatorFixture {
	t.Helper()
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 10, 14, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	const (
		studentID = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
		teacherID = "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
		dialogID  = "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
		promptID  = "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444"
		messageID = "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555"
		jobID     = "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666"
		eventID   = "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777"
		claimID   = "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888"
	)
	direction := "backend"
	version := int64(1)
	answers := domain.StudentOnboardingAnswers{DirectionCode: &direction}
	createdAt, updatedAt := &now, &now
	if step == domain.OnboardingStepDirection {
		version = 0
		answers = domain.StudentOnboardingAnswers{}
		createdAt, updatedAt = nil, nil
	}
	state := domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingState{
		Schema: domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingStateSchema, ProfileVersion: 0,
		Draft: domain.StudentOnboardingDraft{
			Schema: domain.StudentOnboardingDraftSchema, StudentID: studentID, Status: domain.StudentOnboardingDraftDraft,
			StudentOnboardingAnswers: answers,
			Version:                  version, CreatedAt: createdAt, UpdatedAt: updatedAt,
		},
	}
	body, ui, err := domain.BuildTeacherOnboardingPrompt(step, "ru", state.Draft.Version)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	binding, err := domain.NewTeacherDialogBinding(domain.TeacherDialogBinding{
		ID: dialogID, StudentID: studentID, PersonalTeacherID: teacherID, ContextType: domain.LearningContextGeneral,
	})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	prompt := domain.DialogMessage{
		ID: promptID, DialogID: dialogID, AuthorType: domain.DialogMessageAuthorPersonalTeacher, Channel: domain.DialogMessageChannelWeb,
		PersonalTeacherID: teacherID, Body: body, AssistantUI: ui, Status: 1, Version: 1, MessageSequence: 1, LastEventSequence: 1, CreatedAt: now,
	}
	interaction, err := domain.NewS5OnboardingInteraction(binding, prompt, step, state.Draft.Version, 0, 1, now)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	source := domain.DialogMessage{
		ID: messageID, DialogID: dialogID, AuthorType: domain.DialogMessageAuthorUser, Channel: domain.DialogMessageChannelWeb,
		SenderID: studentID, ReplyToMessageID: promptID, Body: "Я знаю основы Go.", Status: 1, Version: 1, MessageSequence: 2, LastEventSequence: 2, CreatedAt: now,
	}
	request := domain.DialogTeacherRequest{
		SchemaVersion: 2, EventID: eventID, DialogID: dialogID, EventSequence: 2, TeacherTurnSequence: 1,
		SourceMessageID: messageID, SourceSequence: 2, SourceMessageVersion: 1, ReplyToMessageID: promptID,
		CanonicalStudentMessageID: messageID, CorrelationID: messageID, DialogCausationID: messageID, CausationID: eventID,
		SourceChannel: domain.DialogMessageChannelWeb, StudentID: studentID, PersonalTeacherID: teacherID, ContextType: domain.LearningContextGeneral, OccurredAt: now,
	}
	job := domain.TeacherDialogJob{TeacherJobID: jobID, Request: request, ClaimToken: claimID, CoordinatorMode: "legacy"}
	slot, found := domain.TeacherOnboardingSlotForStep(step)
	require.True(t, found)
	code := "basic"
	if slot == domain.TeacherOnboardingSlotDirection {
		code = "backend"
	}
	result, err := domain.NormalizeTeacherOnboardingSemanticResult(domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticResult{
		Schema: domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticSchemaCode, Response: "Понял, зафиксирую базовый уровень и продолжим.",
		SlotCandidates: []domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticCandidate{{
			Slot: slot, CodeValue: code, TextValue: "", StringListValue: []string{}, IntegerValue: 0, ConfidenceBasisPoints: 9000,
		}},
		Questions: []domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticQuestion{}, Uncertainties: []domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticUncertainty{},
	})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	_, err = domain.NewTeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision(result, interaction)
	require.NoError(t, err, "the fixture must be a persistable bounded semantic decision")
	jobs := &s5TextJobs{}
	turns := &s5TextTurns{interaction: interaction}
	studentStates := &s5TextStudentStates{state: state}
	studentTurns := &s5TextStudentTurns{states: studentStates}
	semantic := &s5TextSemantic{execution: domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticExecution{Result: result, LanguageCode: "ru", TemplateVersion: 1}}
	contextReader := s5TextDialogContext{value: domain.DialogRequestContext{
		DialogID: dialogID, StudentID: studentID, PersonalTeacherID: teacherID, ContextType: domain.LearningContextGeneral,
		SourceMessageID: messageID, Messages: []domain.DialogMessage{prompt, source},
	}}
	coordinator := OnboardingCoordinator{
		Jobs: jobs, Turns: turns, StudentTurns: studentTurns, Students: studentStates, Semantic: semantic,
		DialogReader: contextReader, Appender: s5TextAppender{}, Deliveries: s5TextDeliveries{}, Clock: s5TextClock{now: now},
	}
	return s5TextCoordinatorFixture{coordinator: coordinator, job: job, jobs: jobs, turns: turns, studentTurns: studentTurns, semantic: semantic, studentStates: studentStates}
}

type s5TextTurns struct {
	interaction      domain.TeacherOnboardingInteraction
	turn             domain.TeacherOnboardingTurn
	hasTurn          bool
	semanticResponse string
}

func (store *s5TextTurns) EnsureTurn(_ context.Context, turn domain.TeacherOnboardingTurn, _ string) (domain.TeacherOnboardingTurn, bool, error) {
	if store.hasTurn {
		return store.turn, false, nil
	}
	normalized, err := domain.NewTeacherOnboardingTurn(turn)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingTurn{}, false, err
	}
	store.turn, store.hasTurn = normalized, true
	return store.turn, true, nil
}
func (store *s5TextTurns) GetTurn(_ context.Context, teacherJobID string) (domain.TeacherOnboardingTurn, bool, error) {
	return store.turn, store.hasTurn && store.turn.TeacherJobID == teacherJobID, nil
}
func (store *s5TextTurns) EnsureActiveInteraction(_ context.Context, interaction domain.TeacherOnboardingInteraction) (domain.TeacherOnboardingInteraction, bool, error) {
	store.interaction = interaction
	return interaction, true, nil
}
func (store *s5TextTurns) GetActiveInteraction(_ context.Context, dialogID, promptID, teacherID string) (domain.TeacherOnboardingInteraction, bool, error) {
	found := store.interaction.DialogID == dialogID && store.interaction.PromptMessageID == promptID && store.interaction.PersonalTeacherID == teacherID &&
		(store.interaction.State == domain.TeacherOnboardingInteractionActive || store.interaction.State == domain.TeacherOnboardingInteractionReserved)
	return store.interaction, found, nil
}
func (store *s5TextTurns) GetInteraction(_ context.Context, dialogID, promptID, teacherID string) (domain.TeacherOnboardingInteraction, bool, error) {
	found := store.interaction.DialogID == dialogID && store.interaction.PromptMessageID == promptID && store.interaction.PersonalTeacherID == teacherID
	return store.interaction, found, nil
}
func (*s5TextTurns) GetConfirmationProposal(context.Context, domain.TeacherOnboardingInteraction) (domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision, bool, error) {
	return domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision{}, false, nil
}
func (store *s5TextTurns) ReserveInteraction(_ context.Context, interactionID, teacherJobID string, mode domain.TeacherOnboardingCoordinatorMode, receiptID string, now time.Time) (domain.TeacherOnboardingInteraction, error) {
	if store.interaction.ID != interactionID || (store.interaction.State == domain.TeacherOnboardingInteractionReserved && store.interaction.ReservedTeacherJobID != teacherJobID) {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingInteraction{}, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	store.interaction.State = domain.TeacherOnboardingInteractionReserved
	store.interaction.ReservedTeacherJobID = teacherJobID
	store.interaction.ReservedActionReceiptID = receiptID
	store.interaction.ReservationMode = mode
	store.interaction.UpdatedAt = now
	value, err := domain.NormalizeTeacherOnboardingInteraction(store.interaction)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingInteraction{}, err
	}
	store.interaction = value
	return value, nil
}
func (store *s5TextTurns) CloseActiveInteractionForTerminal(_ context.Context, dialogID, teacherID string, reason domain.TeacherOnboardingInteractionClosedReason, now time.Time) (domain.TeacherOnboardingInteraction, bool, error) {
	if store.interaction.DialogID != dialogID || store.interaction.PersonalTeacherID != teacherID ||
		(store.interaction.State != domain.TeacherOnboardingInteractionActive && store.interaction.State != domain.TeacherOnboardingInteractionReserved) {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingInteraction{}, false, nil
	}
	if store.interaction.State == domain.TeacherOnboardingInteractionReserved {
		return store.interaction, true, nil
	}
	store.interaction.State = domain.TeacherOnboardingInteractionClosed
	store.interaction.ClosedReason = reason
	store.interaction.ClosedAt = now
	store.interaction.UpdatedAt = now
	return store.interaction, true, nil
}
func (store *s5TextTurns) SaveSemanticDecision(_ context.Context, teacherJobID, _ string, decision domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision, response string, now time.Time) (string, error) {
	if !store.hasTurn || store.turn.TeacherJobID != teacherJobID || store.turn.Stage != domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnAIStaged {
		return "", domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	normalized, err := domain.NormalizeTeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision(decision)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	if store.turn.SemanticDecision != nil && store.turn.SemanticDecision.Digest != normalized.Digest {
		return "", domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	store.turn.SemanticDecision = &normalized
	store.turn.UpdatedAt = now
	if response != "" {
		store.semanticResponse = response
	}
	if store.semanticResponse == "" {
		return "", domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	return store.semanticResponse, nil
}
func (store *s5TextTurns) Advance(_ context.Context, teacherJobID, _ string, expected, next domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnStage, effect domain.TeacherOnboardingStudentEffectState, proofID, outcomeID string, now time.Time) error {
	if !store.hasTurn || store.turn.TeacherJobID != teacherJobID || store.turn.Stage != expected || !domain.CanAdvanceTeacherOnboardingTurn(expected, next) {
		return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	store.turn.Stage, store.turn.StudentEffectState, store.turn.NoEffectProofID, store.turn.RecoverableOutcomeID, store.turn.UpdatedAt = next, effect, proofID, outcomeID, now
	if _, err := domain.NewTeacherOnboardingTurn(store.turn); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return nil
}

type s5TextStudentStates struct {
	state domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingState
}

func (states *s5TextStudentStates) GetTeacherOnboardingState(context.Context, string) (domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingState, error) {
	return states.state, nil
}
func (states *s5TextStudentStates) ReplaceTeacherOnboardingDraft(context.Context, string, string, int64, domain.StudentOnboardingAnswers) (domain.StudentOnboardingDraft, error) {
	return domain.StudentOnboardingDraft{}, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
}
func (states *s5TextStudentStates) FinalizeTeacherOnboardingDraft(context.Context, string, string, int64, int64) (domain.StudentOnboardingFinalizeResponse, error) {
	return domain.StudentOnboardingFinalizeResponse{}, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
}

type s5TextStudentTurns struct {
	states          *s5TextStudentStates
	applyErr        error
	applyCalls      int
	getCalls        int
	command         domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnCommand
	noEffect        bool
	noEffectProofID string
	applied         bool
}

func (turns *s5TextStudentTurns) ApplyTeacherOnboardingTurn(_ context.Context, _ string, command domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnCommand) (domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnResult, error) {
	turns.applyCalls++
	turns.command = command
	if turns.applyErr != nil {
		return domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnResult{}, turns.applyErr
	}
	turns.applyState(command)
	return turns.result(command), nil
}
func (turns *s5TextStudentTurns) GetTeacherOnboardingTurn(_ context.Context, _ string, commandID string) (domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnResult, error) {
	turns.getCalls++
	if turns.command.StudentCommandID == "" || turns.command.StudentCommandID != commandID {
		return domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnResult{}, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingTurnUnknown
	}
	turns.applyState(turns.command)
	return turns.result(turns.command), nil
}
func (turns *s5TextStudentTurns) ProveTeacherOnboardingTurnNoEffect(context.Context, string, string, domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnNoEffectProof) (domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnResult, error) {
	return domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnResult{}, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
}
func (turns *s5TextStudentTurns) applyState(command domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnCommand) {
	if turns.noEffect || turns.applied {
		return
	}
	for _, slot := range command.Slots {
		switch slot.SlotCode {
		case domain.TeacherOnboardingSlotDirection:
			value := *slot.CodeValue
			turns.states.state.Draft.DirectionCode = &value
		case domain.TeacherOnboardingSlotExperience:
			value := *slot.CodeValue
			turns.states.state.Draft.SelfAssessedExperience = &value
		case domain.TeacherOnboardingSlotGoalCode:
			value := *slot.CodeValue
			turns.states.state.Draft.GoalCode = &value
		case domain.TeacherOnboardingSlotLanguage:
			value := *slot.CodeValue
			turns.states.state.Draft.PreferredLanguage = &value
		case domain.TeacherOnboardingSlotDesiredStacks:
			values := append([]string(nil), (*slot.StacksValue)...)
			turns.states.state.Draft.DesiredStacks = &values
		}
	}
	turns.states.state.Draft.Version++
	if turns.states.state.Draft.CreatedAt == nil {
		now := time.Date(2026, 9, 10, 14, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
		turns.states.state.Draft.CreatedAt = &now
		turns.states.state.Draft.UpdatedAt = &now
	}
	turns.applied = true
}
func (turns *s5TextStudentTurns) result(command domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnCommand) domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnResult {
	if turns.noEffect {
		if turns.noEffectProofID == "" {
			turns.noEffectProofID = "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999"
		}
		proofID := turns.noEffectProofID
		return domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnResult{
			Schema: domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnResultSchema, StudentCommandID: command.StudentCommandID,
			CanonicalStudentMessageID: command.CanonicalStudentMessageID, StudentEffectState: "no_effect", NoEffectProofID: &proofID,
		}
	}
	version := turns.states.state.Draft.Version
	return domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnResult{
		Schema: domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnResultSchema, StudentCommandID: command.StudentCommandID,
		CanonicalStudentMessageID: command.CanonicalStudentMessageID, StudentEffectState: "accepted", ResultDraftVersion: &version,
	}
}

type s5TextSemantic struct {
	execution      domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticExecution
	interpretErr   error
	interpretCalls int
	replayCalls    int
	request        domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticRequest
}

func (semantic *s5TextSemantic) InterpretOnboardingSemantic(_ context.Context, request domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticRequest) (domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticExecution, error) {
	semantic.interpretCalls++
	semantic.request = request
	return semantic.execution, semantic.interpretErr
}
func (semantic *s5TextSemantic) ReplayOnboardingSemantic(context.Context, string) (domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticExecution, error) {
	semantic.replayCalls++
	return semantic.execution, nil
}

type s5TextDialogContext struct {
	value domain.DialogRequestContext
	err   error
}

func (reader s5TextDialogContext) GetTeacherRequestContext(context.Context, domain.DialogTeacherRequest, int) (domain.DialogRequestContext, error) {
	return reader.value, reader.err
}

type s5TextAppender struct{}

func (s5TextAppender) AppendTeacherCoordinatedResponse(context.Context, domain.DialogTeacherRequest, string, domain.TeacherCoordinatedDialogResponse) (domain.DialogMessage, error) {
	return domain.DialogMessage{}, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
}

type s5TextDeliveries struct{}

func (s5TextDeliveries) CompleteOnboardingDelivery(context.Context, string, string, string, *domain.TeacherOnboardingInteraction, bool, time.Time) error {
	return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
}

var (
	_ repository.TeacherDialogJob                         = (*s5TextJobs)(nil)
	_ repository.OnboardingActionReceiptLookup            = s5TextReceipts{}
	_ repository.TeacherOnboardingTurnStore               = (*s5TextTurns)(nil)
	_ repository.StudentOnboardingGateway                 = (*s5TextStudentStates)(nil)
	_ repository.TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnGateway      = (*s5TextStudentTurns)(nil)
	_ repository.TeacherOnboardingSemanticInterpreter     = (*s5TextSemantic)(nil)
	_ repository.DialogRequestContextReader               = s5TextDialogContext{}
	_ repository.DialogTeacherCoordinatedResponseAppender = s5TextAppender{}
	_ repository.TeacherOnboardingDeliveryStore           = s5TextDeliveries{}
)
